title: Stop the Automatic Tipping Cycle From Operator Station HMI (Visu_Dual_MCP → CYCLE STOP)
summary: From the operator station HMI, navigate to the "Visu_Dual_MCP" screen (F3) and press CYCLE STOP to stop the automatic tipping cycle so maintenance procedures and/or manual end-effector positioning can be performed.
when_to_use: Use when you need to halt the automatic tipping cycle from the operator station HMI to proceed with maintenance procedures and/or manual end-effector positioning.

access_required: Access to the operator station HMI (tipper VISU/WebVisu) to navigate to "Visu_Dual_MCP" (F3) and press CYCLE STOP.

visual_references.description: Operator Station Control Panel (Visu_MCP_Dual screen) showing the CYCLE STOP button and that active buttons are indicated by illuminated green bars.
Operator station HMI screen for manually referencing axes; includes navigation to "Visu_Dual_MCP" (F3) and the instruction to press CYCLE STOP to stop the automatic tipping cycle.

steps.title: Navigate to the "Visu_Dual_MCP" screen (F3) on the operator station HMI
steps.purpose: Open the correct operator station HMI screen so the CYCLE STOP control can be used to stop the automatic tipping cycle.
steps.instruction: On the operator station HMI, navigate to the "Visu_Dual_MCP" screen (F3).
steps.expected_result: The operator station HMI is displaying the "Visu_Dual_MCP" screen.
steps.healthy_condition: The "Visu_Dual_MCP" screen is active and ready for operator controls (including CYCLE STOP).
steps.failure_condition: You cannot reach the "Visu_Dual_MCP" screen (F3) or the screen shown is not the "Visu_Dual_MCP" interface.

source_evidence.evidence_excerpt: On the operator station HMI, navigate to the "Visu_Dual_MCP" screen (F3). Press CYCLE STOP to stop the automatic tipping cycle.

steps.title: Press CYCLE STOP to stop the automatic tipping cycle
steps.purpose: Halt the automatic tipping cycle so maintenance procedures and/or manual end-effector positioning can proceed.
steps.instruction: Press CYCLE STOP to stop the automatic tipping cycle.
steps.expected_result: The automatic tipping cycle is stopped after pressing CYCLE STOP.
steps.healthy_condition: After pressing CYCLE STOP, the automatic tipping cycle is no longer running.
steps.failure_condition: The automatic cycle does not stop after pressing CYCLE STOP.

actions.label: Stop automatic cycle

stop_or_escalate_if: If the automatic cycle does not stop after pressing CYCLE STOP, stop attempting and escalate for support.
